source.rawText: Synthetic SiteScribe Review Console test package generated for import testing. Contains 30 primary records across event, action, followup, scheduled, safety, communication, and document categories. Some records contain secondary comments and record-level flags; others intentionally contain none.

dailySummary: Synthetic test package with 30 primary SiteScribe records across all valid categories, including a mix of open and closed records, secondary comments, incomplete flags, clarify flags, and records with no secondary entries.
